responsibility: Defines the main Cygwin x86 target configuration layered over the shared PE/COFF Windows support. It contributes Cygwin-specific preprocessor builtins and CPP specs, startup and end file selection, shared-libgcc and system library link specs, optional C++ operator wrapper linkage, pthread/OpenMP driver behavior, libgcc DLL naming, and executable-stack policy for trampolines, so it is the core OS/runtime header describing how GCC targets the Cygwin userspace environment.
same_name_distinction: Unlike cygwin.opt, this header provides the substantive Cygwin OS/runtime target configuration layered on cygming.h, including builtins, specs, library/startfile/link behavior, and executable-stack policy; the .opt file only adds a recognized option spelling.
